def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    S = 85
    K = 90
    r = 0.05
    T = 5
    c = 10
    p = 15

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    # Put-call parity with continuous dividend yield:
    # c - p = S * exp(-qT) - K * exp(-rT)
    import math

    discounted_strike = K * math.exp(-r * T)
    implied_forward_stock = c - p + discounted_strike
    q = -math.log(implied_forward_stock / S) / T

    answer = round(q * 100, 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
